cues: Fibroblasts make the fibres and ground substance.
Macrophages crawl about engulfing bacteria and debris.
Mast cells release heparin, which stops blood clotting inside vessels, and histamine, which drives inflammation and allergy.
Plasma cells make antibodies, and adipocytes store fat.
